newsitem.title: USA: IVAX appoints Strauss as President and COO.
newsitem.headline: IVAX appoints Strauss as President and COO.

text.p: IVAX Corp said it has appointed Robert Strauss as its president and chief operating officer.

Prior to joining IVAX, Strauss was chairman, president and chief executive officer of Cordis Corp, a developer and manufacturer of medical devices which was acquired by Johnson & Johnson in February 1996.
Strauss succeeds Richard Pfenniger as COO. Pfenniger recently resigned his position as IVAX' COO to become the chief executive officer and vice chairman of Whitman Education Group Inc.
IVAX is a holding company with subsidiaries engaged primarily in the research, development, manufacture and marketing of health care products.
